highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 brings Skia m150, composable image filters, and faster CPU blur rendering.

breaking.title: Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs
breaking.body: Remaining pre-v4 warning-only obsoletes become compile errors. Use GRBackendRenderTarget constructors without sampleCount, run-buffer Glyphs/Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality remain in implementation assemblies for ABI compatibility but are absent from reference assemblies. The two DrawText overloads without explicit SKTextAlign remain warnings.

breaking.title: Move off notebook integration
breaking.body: SkiaSharp no longer ships its deprecated .NET Interactive / Polyglot Notebooks extension. Move drawing and display code to a supported application host instead of relying on automatic notebook renderers.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine to milestone 150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and the existing Windows runtime floor.
Refreshes bundled text shaping with AAT, Arabic fallback, COLR v1, and glyph-extents corrections.
CreateCrop clips filter output with a selectable tile mode; CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input.
SKPaint.GetFastBounds supports conservative quick-reject culling. SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a caller-supplied six-color palette.
Restores the faster small-sigma CPU blur path and reuses the SKSurface.Canvas wrapper across repeated accesses.
Corrects a race when opening streams from typefaces shared across threads on Apple platforms.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Completed the pre-v4 deprecation pass, cached surface canvas wrappers, and restored small-sigma CPU blur performance.

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Opened the Skia m150 line while preserving the Windows runtime floor and Tizen PDF support.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Updated bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1, completed the remaining pre-v4 deprecation pass, and retired notebook integration.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Added crop and empty image filters, fast paint bounds, and overdraw visualization. Restored CPU blur performance, cached surface canvases, and corrected the Apple typeface stream race.

harfbuzz_summary: The collected HarfBuzz-specific work updates the test harness; it does not introduce binding or shaping behavior changes.

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.headline: Preview 1 opened the 4.150 line with Skia m150.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.headline: Preview 2 updated bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1, completed the pre-v4 deprecation pass, and retired notebook integration.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.headline: The release candidate added crop and empty image filters, paint bounds and overdraw diagnostics, and restored CPU blur performance.

v4.150.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 promotes the release candidate to stable without additional collected changes.
